description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Wegiriya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District (24/1166)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registrations and property ownership matters. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including owner names, parcel numbers, locations, and property details. The content falls under "Land Gazettes" as it primarily concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title settlements under the Registration of Title Act.
